title: Intellectual Inquiry
statementMd:
After getting kicked out of her reporting job for not knowing the alphabet, Bessie has decided to attend school at the Fillet and Eggs Eater Academy. She has been making good progress with her studies and now knows the first $*k*$ English letters.

Each morning, Bessie travels to school along a sidewalk consisting of $*m* + *n*$ tiles. In order to help Bessie review, Mr. Moozing has labeled each of the first $*m*$ sidewalk tiles with one of the first $*k*$ lowercase English letters, spelling out a string $*t*$. Mr. Moozing, impressed by Bessie's extensive knowledge of farm animals, plans to let her finish labeling the last $*n*$ tiles of the sidewalk by herself.

Consider the resulting string $*s*$ ($|*s*| = *m* + *n*$) consisting of letters labeled on tiles in order from home to school. For any sequence of indices $*p*_{1} < *p*_{2} < ... < *p*_{*q*}$ we can define subsequence of the string $*s*$ as string $*s*_{*p*_{1}}*s*_{*p*_{2}}... *s*_{*p*_{*q*}}$. Two subsequences are considered to be distinct if they differ as strings. Bessie wants to label the remaining part of the sidewalk such that the number of **distinct subsequences** of tiles is maximum possible. However, since Bessie hasn't even finished learning the alphabet, she needs your help!

Note that empty subsequence also counts.

## Input

The first line of the input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($0 ≤ *n* ≤ 1 000 000$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ 26$).

The second line contains a string $*t*$ ($|*t*| = *m*, 1 ≤ *m* ≤ 1 000 000$) consisting of only first $*k*$ lowercase English letters.

## Output

Determine the maximum number of distinct subsequences Bessie can form after labeling the last $*n*$ sidewalk tiles each with one of the first $*k*$ lowercase English letters. Since this number can be rather large, you should print it modulo $10^{9} + 7$.

Please note, that you are not asked to maximize the remainder modulo $10^{9} + 7$! The goal is to maximize the initial value and then print the remainder.

## Note

In the first sample, the optimal labeling gives $8$ different subsequences: "" (the empty string), "`a`", "`c`", "`b`", "`ac`", "`ab`", "`cb`", and "`acb`".

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a824b8670a41c1a171e71791b55d5184d6b34c59.png)

In the second sample, the entire sidewalk is already labeled. The are $10$ possible different subsequences: "" (the empty string), "`a`", "`b`", "`aa`", "`ab`", "`ba`", "`aaa`", "`aab`", "`aba`", and "`aaba`". Note that some strings, including "`aa`", can be obtained with multiple sequences of tiles, but are only counted once.
statementZhMd:
被举报工作因不认识字母而解雇后，Bessie 决定到 Fillet and Eggs Eater Academy 上学。她的学习进展顺利，现在已经认识前 $*k*$ 个英文字母。

每天早晨，Bessie 沿着一条由 $*m* + *n*$ 块砖组成的人行道去学校。为了帮助 Bessie 复习，Moozing 先生用前 $*k*$ 个小写英文字母之一标记了人行道最前面的 $*m*$ 块砖，拼成字符串 $*t*$。Moozing 先生对 Bessie 丰富的农场动物知识印象深刻，计划让她独自完成对人行道最后 $*n*$ 块砖的标记。

考虑由此得到的字符串 $*s*$（$|*s*| = *m* + *n*$），它由从家到学校依次排列的砖块上的字母组成。对于任意一组下标 $*p*_{1} < *p*_{2} < ... < *p*_{*q*}$，我们可以将字符串 $*s*_{*p*_{1}}*s*_{*p*_{2}}... *s*_{*p*_{*q*}}$ 定义为字符串 $*s*$ 的一个子序列。如果两个子序列作为字符串不相同，则认为它们是不同的。Bessie 希望为人行道的剩余部分标记字母，使砖块的**不同子序列**数量尽可能多。然而，由于 Bessie 甚至还没有学完字母表，她需要你的帮助！

注意，空子序列也会被计入。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$0 ≤ *n* ≤ 1 000 000$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 26$）。

第二行包含一个字符串 $*t*$（$|*t*| = *m*$，$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 1 000 000$），其中只包含前 $*k*$ 个小写英文字母。

## 输出格式

求出 Bessie 为人行道最后 $*n*$ 块砖分别标记前 $*k*$ 个小写英文字母之一后，能够得到的不同子序列的最大数量。由于这个数可能很大，请将其对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模后输出。

请注意，你不需要最大化对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模后的余数！目标是先最大化原始数值，然后输出其余数。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，最优标记方案可以得到 8 个不同的子序列：""（空字符串）、`a`、`c`、`b`、`ac`、`ab`、`cb` 和 `acb`。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a824b8670a41c1a171e71791b55d5184d6b34c59.png)

在第二个样例中，整条人行道已经完成标记。共有 10 个不同的子序列：""（空字符串）、`a`、`b`、`aa`、`ab`、`ba`、`aaa`、`aab`、`aba` 和 `aaba`。注意，包括 `aa` 在内的一些字符串可以由多组砖块下标得到，但每个字符串只会被计数一次。
